title: 雅思 7 分+ · 跟读 4 句

items.text: The internationalisation of higher education has undoubtedly reshaped university funding, yet its long term effect on sending countries remains genuinely contested.
items.translationCn: 高等教育的国际化无疑重塑了大学的经费结构，但它对生源国的长期影响仍然存在真正的争议。
items.ipa: /ði ˌɪntəˌnæʃnəlaɪˈzeɪʃn əv ˈhaɪər ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn həz ʌnˈdaʊtɪdli ˌriːˈʃeɪpt ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsəti ˈfʌndɪŋ jet ɪts lɒŋ tɜːm ɪˈfekt ɒn ˈsendɪŋ ˈkʌntriz rɪˈmeɪnz ˈdʒenjuɪnli kənˈtestɪd/

items.text: What ought to be regulated is not the technology itself but the finality of the decisions it is allowed to make.
items.translationCn: 应当受到监管的不是技术本身，而是它被允许作出的决定的终局性。
items.ipa: /wɒt ɔːt tə bi ˈreɡjuleɪtɪd ɪz nɒt ðə tekˈnɒlədʒi ɪtˈself bət ðə faɪˈnæləti əv ðə dɪˈsɪʒnz ɪt ɪz əˈlaʊd tə meɪk/

items.text: Even if an algorithm outperforms human assessors on average, it remains the case that its errors tend to be systematically correlated.
items.translationCn: 即便算法平均表现优于人类评估者，其错误仍然倾向于系统性地相互关联。
items.ipa: /ˈiːvn ɪf ən ˈælɡərɪðəm ˌaʊtpəˈfɔːmz ˈhjuːmən əˈsesəz ɒn ˈævərɪdʒ ɪt rɪˈmeɪnz ðə keɪs ðət ɪts ˈerəz tend tə bi ˌsɪstəˈmætɪkli ˈkɒrəleɪtɪd/

items.text: Had policymakers negotiated genuine research partnerships alongside student mobility, the balance of benefit would look considerably less lopsided today.
items.translationCn: 倘若决策者在推动学生流动的同时谈成了实质性的研究伙伴关系，今天的收益格局会远没有这么失衡。
items.ipa: /həd ˈpɒləsimeɪkəz nɪˈɡəʊʃieɪtɪd ˈdʒenjuɪn rɪˈsɜːtʃ ˈpɑːtnəʃɪps əˈlɒŋsaɪd ˈstjuːdnt məʊˈbɪləti ðə ˈbæləns əv ˈbenɪfɪt wʊd lʊk kənˈsɪdərəbli les ˈlɒpsaɪdɪd təˈdeɪ/
